Name: Craftable Junimo Chests
Author: jaqqc
Description:
[s]Do you want more than two junimo chests? (And didn't realise more than two can be bougth, like I didn't until being 99% ready with this mod...)[/s] 
Have you ever wanted to craft your own Junimo Chests! If that's the case, then this mod is for you. 
The recipe can be purchased from Mr. Qi for 40 Qi Gems (configurable) and the default cost is 2 radioactive bars, 150 stone and 5 battery packs. Each quantity can be changed. Additionally radioactive bars can be changed to iridium bars, stone to wood and battery packs to prismatic shards. 

Este mod está disponible también en español. 
Puedes comprar la receta para construir cofres junimo en la tienda de Señor Qi. Cuesta 40 gemas Qi pero se puede configurar tan el precio como la receta.
